name: Deadly clumps vs Tough(3) + Regeneration (#401). Run with --ai-profile tactician so the AI shoots on its first activation (the default solo bot advances 6.6" first and forfeits the shot; it then fires in round 2). The AI's Melta Team (4x Deadly(3), AP(4) - no save possible at D5) stands on the only objective and shoots YOUR Brute Squad: three Tough(3) Regeneration models, the third already down to 1 wound. Watch for: 'N failed save(s) become clump(s) of 3', a Regeneration roll of 3 dice PER CLUMP, the Assign Wounds panel reading 'landed / lost' and 'Next: clump k of n', the first clump forced onto the wounded model with '... lost - a Deadly clump does not carry over', and the untouched model staying untouched. Realistic dice, seeded.
